nora: Quick heads-up  I updated the hello-go quickstart to use SDK v5 client and added a tiny troubleshooting section for invalid token errors. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/868

"Troubleshooting: invalid token
If you see a 401/403, ensure REDWOOD_API_KEY is set and the token has `generate` scope. For CI use a service token and never check tokens into source control."
maria: small nit: link `service token` to /docs/security/service-tokens and add example scopes `scopes: generate`
